# Saffron of Kashmir

> Premium Kashmiri Mongra saffron, harvested in Pampore, Kashmir.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saffronofkashmir.com/): Products, ordering information, FAQ, and the brand story.
- [Products](https://saffronofkashmir.com/products): Full product catalogue. In stock: Royal Mongra 2g, Collector's Tin 5g and Heritage Reserve 10g. Out of stock: Kashmiri Kahwa Blend 100g. Coming soon: Saffron Honey 500ml and Saffron Oil 15ml.
- [Recipes](https://saffronofkashmir.com/recipes): Tested saffron recipes: Kashmiri Kahwa, Zafrani Pulao, Kesar Doodh and Arabic Saffron Machboos.
- [Blog](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blogs): Guides: What is Mongra Grade Saffron and Why It Matters, The Saffron Fields of Pampore: A Centuries-Old Legacy, How to Test Saffron Purity at Home (3 Methods), Using Kashmiri Saffron in Arabic Cuisine and Health Benefits of Saffron Backed by Research.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://saffronofkashmir.com/terms): Terms of sale for Saffron of Kashmir: how orders are made, prices, liability and governing law.
- [Shipping Policy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/shipping-policy): Where we ship, transit times, shipping charges, and who pays customs duties on international orders.
- [Returns Policy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/returns-policy): Returns for unopened tins within 7 days, replacements for parcels lost or damaged in transit, and what is not a defect.
- [Privacy Policy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/privacy-policy): What personal data we collect, who processes it, how long we keep it, and your rights under the DPDP Act 2023.
